mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.source_itinerary_id, c.author_nickname, c.title, c.country, c.city, c.traveler_count, i.thumbnail_img, c.added_at FROM TB_ITINERARY_CART c LEFT JOIN TB_ITINERARY i ON i.itinerary_id = c.source_itinerary_id WHERE c.user_id = #{value} ORDER BY c.added_at DESC, c.cart_id DESC

SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.source_itinerary_id, c.author_nickname, c.title, c.country, c.city, c.traveler_count, i.thumbnail_img, c.added_at FROM TB_ITINERARY_CART c LEFT JOIN TB_ITINERARY i ON i.itinerary_id = c.source_itinerary_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.added_at DESC, c.cart_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT day_cart_id, cart_id, source_day_id, day_order, day_date, title FROM TB_ITINERARY_DAY_CART WHERE cart_id = #{value} ORDER BY day_order ASC, day_cart_id ASC

SELECT block_cart_id, day_cart_id, source_block_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_lat, place_lng, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, cost_type, start_time, end_time FROM TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK_CART WHERE day_cart_id = #{value} ORDER BY block_order ASC, block_cart_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_CART ( user_id, source_itinerary_id, author_nickname, title, country, city, traveler_count ) SELECT #{userId}, i.itinerary_id, u.nickname, i.title, i.country, i.city, i.traveler_count FROM TB_ITINERARY i JOIN TB_USER u ON u.user_id = i.user_id WHERE i.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( i.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR i.user_id = #{userId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cart_id = cart_id

INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_DAY_CART ( cart_id, source_day_id, day_order, day_date, title ) SELECT c.cart_id, d.day_id, d.day_order, d.day_date, d.title FROM TB_ITINERARY_DAY d JOIN TB_ITINERARY_CART c ON c.source_itinerary_id = d.itinerary_id WHERE c.cart_id = #{cartId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND d.day_id = #{dayId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE day_cart_id = day_cart_id

INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK_CART ( day_cart_id, source_block_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_lat, place_lng, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, cost_type, start_time, end_time ) SELECT dc.day_cart_id, b.block_id, b.google_place_id, b.place_name, b.place_address, b.place_lat, b.place_lng, b.block_type, b.block_order, b.title, b.memo, b.cost, b.cost_type, b.start_time, b.end_time FROM TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK b JOIN TB_ITINERARY_DAY d ON d.day_id = b.day_id JOIN TB_ITINERARY_DAY_CART dc ON dc.source_day_id = d.day_id JOIN TB_ITINERARY_CART c ON c.cart_id = dc.cart_id AND c.source_itinerary_id = d.itinerary_id WHERE dc.day_cart_id = #{dayCartId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND b.block_id = #{blockId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE block_cart_id = block_cart_id
mapper.delete: DELETE bc FROM TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK_CART bc JOIN TB_ITINERARY_DAY_CART dc ON dc.day_cart_id = bc.day_cart_id JOIN TB_ITINERARY_CART c ON c.cart_id = dc.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND bc.source_block_id = #{blockId}
DELETE c FROM TB_ITINERARY_CART c LEFT JOIN TB_ITINERARY_DAY_CART dc ON dc.cart_id = c.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cart_id = #{cartId} AND dc.day_cart_id IS NULL
